args: Activate the morning-brief skill: check ./bin/hq status, today's calendar, local/inbox/, active worktrees, and investment watchlist, then save today's Morning Brief to local/notes/general/brief-YYYY-MM-DD.md.
description: Every morning at 7:30 AM (America/Los_Angeles), generates the daily Morning Brief across calendar, inbox, engineering worktrees, and investment watchlist.
